long_biography.plain_text:
Vincent Bastide's first operating test in the family medical business was its struggling Nîmes branch. Determined to demonstrate his ability, he worked through the week and personally vacuumed the premises each morning. He then managed several branches and a region before moving into group operations.

A change in nursing-home reimbursement forced a broader rethink. With the business heavily dependent on stores, he shifted expansion towards franchises and recruited specialists in respiratory assistance and diabetes support. Acquisitions added further technical services, while a scientific committee helped identify future medical needs. An acquired British subsidiary developed its home respiratory services.
